components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact filled action for the primary journey or booking step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 43px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--cta-button, #ed8500); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(142,75,0,.16); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9a4e00; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #844300; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained outline action used when the primary path must remain dominant.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 43px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid #8a9aae; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #002040); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--orange, #fd6803); background: rgba(253,104,3,.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(253,104,3,.1); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: The turquoise orientation label that introduces a section or editorial promise.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; color: var(--teal, #009fc0); font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A calm, lightly bordered field for traveler details and requests.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted, #435d77); font: 400 10px/1.45 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid #d6d0ca; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.26); color: var(--text, #002040); font: 400 11px/1.45 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); outline: none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #b9b0a7; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #c66a00; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(221,121,8,.13); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #566f85; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Feature Chip
components.description: An outlined metadata capsule used for journey features.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 5px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ded8d2); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #435d77); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--teal, #009fc0); color: var(--text, #002040); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip:active { background: rgba(0,159,192,.08); }

components.css: .ds-journey-card { width: min(403px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ded8d2); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--text, #002040); font-family: var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-journey-image { display: block; width: 100%; height: 160px; } .ds-journey-body { padding: 18px; } .ds-journey-body h3 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 600 27px/1.1 var(--font-display, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.013em; } .ds-journey-body p { margin: 13px 0 12px; color: var(--muted, #435d77); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-journey-body .ds-journey-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; } .ds-journey-tags { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-journey-tags span { padding: 5px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ded8d2); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted, #435d77); font-size: 12px; } .ds-journey-body footer { padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--soft-line, #ede7e1); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-journey-body footer strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-journey-body footer a { color: #038ab1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-journey-body footer a:hover { color: var(--orange, #fd6803); } .ds-journey-body footer a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact shared-header navigation with a thin orange active marker.
components.html: JourneysAbout usContact us
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 37px; color: var(--text, #002040); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--orange, #fd6803); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav .ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -12px; height: 2px; background: var(--orange, #fd6803); }

components.css: .ds-accordion { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ded8d2); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.32); color: var(--text, #002040); font-family: var(--font-ui, Manrope, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-accordion summary { min-height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-accordion summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-accordion summary:hover { background: rgba(255,250,246,.72); } .ds-accordion summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(253,104,3,.38); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-accordion summary span { color: var(--orange, #fd6803); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-accordion[open] summary span { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-accordion p { margin: 0; padding: 17px 18px 19px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #ded8d2); color: var(--muted, #435d77); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.78; }

narrative.overview:
TheVTravel feels like a well-kept travel journal opened beside the Nile: warm, spacious, personal, and quietly assured. Editorial serif typography gives destinations and promises a sense of place, while compact sans-serif interface copy keeps planning direct and dependable.

The system is light and image-led, with warm paper surfaces flowing into Egyptian travel photography through soft masks rather than hard frames. Deep navy provides structure, turquoise marks orientation, and orange is reserved for actions, active states, fine rules, route lines, and small moments of guidance.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory editorial canvases with pale, precise separators.
Deep navy Cormorant Garamond headings paired with Manrope interface copy.
Turquoise uppercase eyebrows and restrained orange interaction accents.
Felucca, Nile, monument, and journey photography softened into the page.
Generous desktop compositions that stack into direct single-column mobile flows.
Shared, logo-led navigation and a calm information-rich footer.

rules.name: The Orange Thread Rule
rules.body: Orange should read as a continuous journey cue: actions, short rules, route lines, active states, and icon outlines—not as a large-area background.

rules.name: The Paper, Not White Rule
rules.body: Large light surfaces use warm ivory; pure white is reserved for contained elements that need subtle separation.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif type expresses place and promise; sans-serif type handles every action, label, instruction, and piece of operational detail.

rules.name: The Compact Hero Rule
rules.body: Large headings are tightly led and slightly tracked in, with line breaks chosen for a composed editorial silhouette rather than a wide banner.

rules.name: The Editorial Split Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, pair a composed text block with an immersive visual field; on mobile, preserve the reading order by stacking copy before imagery.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be separated with spacing, tone, or a one-pixel border, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Circles Mean Guidance Rule
rules.body: Use circles for landmarks, steps, people, reassurance, and wayfinding—not as a generic container for every control.

dos: Do begin new surfaces from the shared warm ivory, navy, turquoise, and orange vocabulary.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for emotional hierarchy and Manrope for every operational layer.
Do preserve generous editorial whitespace while keeping controls compact and scannable.
Do blend Egyptian travel photography into the page with intentional masks or gradients.
Do provide visible focus, hover, active, expanded, current, error, and disabled states where applicable.
Do stack split layouts into a logical single-column reading order on mobile.
donts: Don't flood a screen with orange; its scarcity makes the journey thread and primary action meaningful.
Don't substitute bright white for the warm paper canvas or add cool gray surfaces that flatten the atmosphere.
Don't use heavy shadows, glassmorphism, oversized radii, or floating rounded cards as the default layout language.
Don't place editorial serif type on controls, labels, form help, or navigation.
Don't hard-cut photography into the copy field when a soft mask is part of the composition.
